title: Task Manager
description: HTTP traffic, business events, JVM and database pool of the Task Manager service.

panels.title: Status
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape the application on the last attempt.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Time since the JVM started.

panels.title: Request rate
panels.description: API requests per second over the last 5 minutes, actuator endpoints excluded.

panels.title: 5xx errors
panels.description: Share of API responses with a 5xx status over the last 5 minutes.

targets.expr: (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*", outcome="SERVER_ERROR"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / (sum(rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) > 0)

panels.title: p95 latency
panels.description: 95% of API requests over the last 5 minutes finished faster than this.

panels.title: Heap used
panels.description: Used heap as a share of the maximum heap size.

panels.title: Request rate by outcome
panels.description: API requests per second grouped by response class.

panels.title: Latency percentiles
panels.description: API response time percentiles, actuator endpoints excluded.

panels.title: Requests by endpoint
panels.description: Number of requests per endpoint in the selected time range. Requests rejected by Spring Security before reaching a controller (401) are reported as UNKNOWN.

panels.title: p95 latency by endpoint
panels.description: 95th percentile of response time per endpoint in the selected time range. UNKNOWN groups requests rejected by Spring Security before reaching a controller.

targets.expr: sort_desc(histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, method, uri) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_bucket{application="$application", instance=~"$instance", uri!~"/actuator.*"}[$__range]))) > 0)

panels.title: Responses by status code
panels.description: Number of responses per HTTP status in the selected time range.

panels.title: Tasks created
panels.description: Tasks created in the selected time range.

panels.title: Released to pool
panels.description: Tasks released back to the shared pool in the selected time range.

panels.title: Tasks deleted
panels.description: Tasks deleted in the selected time range.

panels.title: Failed logins
panels.description: Rejected login attempts in the selected time range.

panels.title: Task operations
panels.description: Task operations per minute.

panels.title: Status transitions
panels.description: Task status changes in the selected time range, including releases back to the pool.

panels.title: Logins
panels.description: Login attempts per minute.

panels.title: Heap memory
panels.description: Heap used and committed by the JVM. The share of the maximum is in the Heap used stat.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU used by the JVM process and by the whole container.

panels.title: Time paused in GC
panels.description: Share of wall-clock time the application spent in garbage collection pauses.

panels.title: Threads
panels.description: Live and daemon JVM threads.

panels.title: Log events
panels.description: WARN and ERROR log records per minute.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: HikariCP pool: connections in use, idle, threads waiting for one, and the pool size.

panels.title: Connection acquire time
panels.description: How long requests wait to get a connection from the pool.

panels.title: Connection timeouts
panels.description: Requests that gave up waiting for a free connection in the selected time range.
